engine.implementation: pqctoday-hsm softhsmv3 C++ (OpenSSL 3.6 backend), native macOS shared library libsofthsmv3.dylib
engine.sourceCommitEvidence: Built from a clean detached worktree created for this run (git -C pqctoday-hsm worktree add --detach pqctoday-hsm-mac-7795799b 7795799b…; `git submodule update --init` of hash-sigs @21294a0f and xmss-reference @171ccbd2 only; liboqs not needed with WITH_LIBOQS=OFF). `git status --porcelain` was empty before and after the build (CMake writes only the gitignored src/vendor/pkcs11-provider/src/config.h into the tree); the worktree was removed afterwards. Same commit as the C++ WASM bundle (wasm-provenance.json softhsm-cpp-engine).

build.compiler: Apple clang version 21.0.0 (clang-2100.3.34.2), target arm64-apple-darwin25.6.0; Xcode 27.0 (27A266a); macOS SDK 27.0 (Mach-O LC_BUILD_VERSION: platform macOS, minos 26.0, sdk 27.0)
build.features: WITH_LIBOQS=OFF (Classic McEliece only; matches the WASM and Linux builds)
build.location: macOS host (Apple M5 Max, macOS 26.6.2 build 25G83), native arm64 with the Xcode toolchain — permitted for the macOS row only (acvp-gap-closure plan §P4); build directory in the session scratchpad, removed after the runs

entropy.source: OpenSSL 3.6.3 default DRBG, seeded from the operating system entropy source (OpenSSL 'os' seed source on macOS)

notes: OpenSSL: Homebrew openssl@3 3.6.3 (/opt/homebrew/Cellar/openssl@3/3.6.3, arm64 bottle); the dylib's load command references /opt/homebrew/opt/openssl@3/lib/libcrypto.3.dylib (and libssl.3.dylib). Homebrew's current stable is 3.6.4; it was NOT upgraded for this run, so the runtime OpenSSL recorded below is 3.6.3.
Reproducibility: a second build into a separate build directory (same host, same toolchain) produced the identical SHA-256 3fb20289df65daf81e8f8db93e633a63326fb79efdbf7914a78d206e978981c4.
Mach-O install name: @rpath/libsofthsmv3.dylib; other dependencies are /usr/lib/libc++.1.dylib and /usr/lib/libSystem.B.dylib.
